accessibility_checks: Each regime named in panel title.

alt_text: Three rows show period 2 at a 0.8 b 0.1, period 7 at a 1.25 b 0.3, and an unresolved trajectory at a 1.4 b 0.3. Left panels plot all 512 saved pairs of x and y; right panels plot the final 48 x and y values with solid and dashed lines. The unresolved trajectory has many distinct states, without an asymptotic chaos claim.
claim_scope_exclusions: No verified neural cycle or shrimp geometry claim.
No statistical generalization beyond these finite pilot tasks.

aggregation_and_transformation: Post-run illustrative selection: lexicographically smallest (a,b,trial_id) verified attracting period-2 and period-7 trials; largest (a,b,trial_id) unresolved trial.
Use all 512 saved states for phase portraits and final 48 states for time traces; no new map iterations.
Connecting line segments indicate discrete update ordering, not continuous flow between iterates.
data_source.exclusions: 62 other controls are omitted from this illustrative view and retained in the complete map.
